rows.question: I designed this as an RC low-pass with a 1 kHz cutoff, but it rolls off far too early. What is wrong?
rows.answer: C1 is 1 µF, 10x too large. With R1 = 1.6 k: fc = 1/(2π·1600·1e-6) ≈ 99.5 Hz, which is why it rolls off a decade early. Change C1 to 100n: 1/(2π·1600·100e-9) ≈ 995 Hz ≈ 1 kHz. R1 is fine as-is.
